title: Payment retries move off the request path
subtitle: A soft card decline now queues a retry instead of failing the checkout.
summary: Recommendation: **approve once the idempotency key lands.**

sections.title: Fewer lost checkouts, one new queue
Declines now loop through a queue

figure.claim: Step through the change with →: before, the new branch, the worker.

blocks.prose: Hard declines keep throwing. Soft ones enqueue attempt 1 and return `pending`, so checkout answers immediately.

steps.title: Queue
steps.body: A soft decline lands on payment-retries.

steps.title: Consume
steps.body: The worker picks it up and charges again.

steps.title: Settle
steps.body: Paid, re-queued with backoff, or failed after the third attempt.

risks.risk: A retried charge can double-bill if Stripe succeeded but the response was lost.
Orders can sit in `pending` for up to ~3 minutes.

checklist.text: Idempotency key on the retried charge

callout.title: Recommendation
callout.body: Approve once the idempotency key lands. The request path gets simpler and the retry policy lives in one worker.
